message: Story S6 (Control panel wiring) completed successfully. Worker implemented all control signal management features: persistent toggles (pause, stop_soft, stop_hard) and one-shot actions (skip_iteration, review_now, review_next) with proper state management and auto-reset behavior. All acceptance criteria verified. Two stories remain: S7 (Events tail viewer) and S8 (Engine launch panel and command generator). Recommend continuing to S7.
